name: aahar-sathi
description: Aahar Sathi — personalised 7-day Indian meal plans with calorie and macro targets

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
